Hi Emily --

- Goal: Validate security controls and finalize procurement checklist for a Q2 pilot (target start: 2027-05-02).
- Systems in scope (as discussed): EHR integration (FHIR endpoints), customer PII storage, analytics pipeline (Redshift), SSO (SAML), and audit/logging.
- Decision timeline: Procurement + Security sign-off expected by 2027-04-15 to hit pilot date.

Action items / asks for Ava Health: 
1) Confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact so we can include them on the mutual action plan.
2) Share security/legal contacts who will own the questionnaire and evidence requests.
3) Confirm any data residency / encryption-at-rest keys (KMS/HSM) requirements.

I've attached a short post-call notes PDF and our standard security questionnaire intake to speed the kickoff (see attachments).

Proposed next meeting: 60-minute security kickoff with security + procurement present -- are you available next week on Tue/Wed afternoon (Mar 22/23)?

Thanks -- looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
